framework.name: HIPAA Security & Breach Notification Rules
framework.scope: 45 CFR Parts 160 & 164 — Administrative, Physical, Technical Safeguards; Breach Notification

csp.name: Microsoft Azure
csp.shared_resp: Microsoft is responsible for the security OF the cloud (physical datacenters, hardware, host OS / hypervisor, networking infrastructure, managed-service backplane). The customer is responsible for security IN the cloud (identity, encryption configuration, logging, network controls, application code, data classification, and governance).

foundational_services.name: Azure Activity Log + Entra audit/sign-in logs

purpose_paragraph: Minimal test of the builder with HIPAA's R/A type column. A signed BAA with Microsoft must precede any ePHI processing.

evidence_sourcing_principles.name: Six-year retention.
evidence_sourcing_principles.body: §164.316(b)(2)(i) requires documentation retained at least six years.

evidence_sourcing_principles.name: BAA prerequisite.
evidence_sourcing_principles.body: A signed Microsoft Products and Services DPA + BAA is precondition to ePHI processing.

rows.name: Risk Analysis
rows.description: Conduct an accurate and thorough assessment of the potential risks and vulnerabilities to the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of ePHI.
rows.services: Microsoft Defender for Cloud; Microsoft Purview; Azure Policy
rows.evidence: Annual HIPAA Security Risk Analysis document; Defender for Cloud misconfiguration findings export.

rows.name: Encryption and Decryption
rows.description: Implement a mechanism to encrypt and decrypt ePHI.
rows.services: Azure Key Vault; Azure Key Vault Managed HSM
rows.evidence: CMK configuration on all storage services holding ePHI; rotation period set.

inherited.why: Physical access to Azure datacenters is operated by Microsoft.
inherited.evidence: Microsoft Azure SOC 2 Type II report (Service Trust Portal).

extra_xlsx_tabs.title: Required vs Addressable
rows: Implement, implement an alternative, or document why neither is required. NOT optional.

evidence_retention_bullets: Use immutable Azure Storage (locked retention) for evidence archive.
